patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Bombora and Outreach share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Bombora only if your buying job matches “Intent-data specialist (Company Surge®) for B2B account prioritization — not a contact dat” rather than Outreach's shape. Choose Outreach only if your buying job matches “Enterprise sales engagement / AI revenue platform — Amplify Essentials/Core/Plus/Pro packa” rather than Bombora's shape. Workflow advantage: Bombora leans data-enrichment; Outreach leans sales-engagement. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Bombora and Outreach share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Bombora is Intent-data specialist (Company Surge®) for B2B account prioritization — not a contact database; custom-quote packaging.; Outreach is Enterprise sales engagement / AI revenue platform — Amplify Essentials/Core/Plus/Pro packages; request pricing (seat + AI credits)..
- Workflow coverage skew: Bombora-leaning data-enrichment vs Outreach-leaning sales-engagement.
- Researched limits: Bombora — Intent-data specialist — not a B2B email/phone contact database; Outreach — Not a contact database peer — weak as SI data/enrichment core.

Limitations — Bombora: Intent-data specialist — not a B2B email/phone contact database; Custom-quote only via speak-to-an-expert path; Outreach: Not a contact database peer — weak as SI data/enrichment core; No published dollar pricing — enterprise quote only.

Poor-fit cases: Bombora is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Intent-data specialist — not a B2B email/phone contact database · Outreach is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a contact database peer — weak as SI data/enrichment core · Avoid Bombora if you actually need Outreach's motion (Enterprise sales engagement / AI revenue platform — Amplify Essentials/Core/Plus)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
